shots.line: If your AI product videos keep getting restricted, look at the label first.
shots.room: bright home office desk ring light

shots.line: Most AI videos get caught by the same small things. The writing on the product melts.
The bottle changes size between shots. The hand has an extra finger.
So before you post, pause on three frames. I made a free seven point check. Comment check.

twin.title: My AI clip put me in the wrong room
hook: I asked for a living room
AI put me in my kitchen

shots.line: My AI clip put me back in my kitchen. I asked for a living room.
shots.room: bright modern living room large windows

shots.line: The AI copied the background from my face photo, because I took that photo in my kitchen.
So I cut the background out of my photo, and told it the room comes from one picture only.
Now it stays in the right room. That's one point on my free seven point check. Comment check.
